deltas.delta: The publicnode builds accept a fourth eth_call parameter with a block number override. With number 98,688,599, 98,688,600, 98,688,601 and 99,000,000 the probe saw NUMBER equal to the override, CLZ(0x1e) = 251, two MULMOD words equal to the reference, and EXTCODESIZE 0 with the empty code hash at all five Salvador targets. BlockAlloc code is written during block finalisation, so an eth_call override cannot show whether a build carries Salvador.
Polygon blocks now come every 1.50 seconds (blocks 97,823,792 to 98,029,051), so Salvador at 98,688,600 falls at about 2026-12-08 14:00 UTC, about 11.5 hours after BNB Chain's Jenner.
deltas.source: eth_getBlockByNumber latest (98,029,051, timestamp 1795749054) and 0x5d4ac30 via https://polygon-bor-rpc.publicnode.com

deltas.delta: A timing probe of 1,760,000 MULMODs per call, one modulus against two alternating full-width moduli, gave median times of 0.38 s and 0.37 s on publicnode, against 0.49 and 0.50 s on BNB Chain and 0.39 and 0.38 s on Avalanche. The round trip hides the cost of the reciprocal, so the probe cannot tell whether the private builds carry the MULMOD memo. One Polygon answer came back in 0.093 s, which suggests a response cache in front of some backends.

leadResults.answer: The private builds accept a block number override (98,688,599 to 99,000,000), and under number 98,688,601 all 185,529 battery and targeted vectors return the specified word on the rotating builds f2a2d63e69f6, 280514fa9fb7, a863b8e5cce1, ebcfea01452d and cb3d19c5f690. Whether a build carries Salvador cannot be seen this way: Salvador's only effect is the BlockAlloc code write during finalisation, which eth_call does not run, and the five targets show no code under the override. A timing probe could not tell whether the MULMOD memo is present, because the round trip hides it.

Not reached. bsc.api.pocket.network answered three trace requests for block 135,822,728 from Geth v1.8.2 with 'required historical state unavailable (reexec=128)'. The window stays at 14,274 transactions with no mismatch.

The failed transaction 0x52cea783...c269 was traced on avax.api.pocket.network (avalanchego 1.15.2): both PoolManager unlock frames return normally and settle exactly the swap amounts, and the revert comes from the router after the PoolManager returned. 225 more window transactions were traced and match the source model, so 14,966 of 20,000 are covered and 5,034 remain, because most pocket backends still refuse debug_traceTransaction.

Block 98,688,600 is not reached (head 98,029,051 on 2026-11-27, about 2026-12-08 14:00 UTC at 1.5 s per block). No tagged release carries Salvador, and the develop BlockAlloc table lists no address the PoolManager, PositionManager or a pooled currency uses beyond WPOL, 0x1010 and 0x1001, which were judged before. Governance level.

No release carries Salvador yet. develop core/vm/mulmod_memo.go is byte equal to the copy cycles 26 and 28 read, which keys on the full modulus and calls MulModWithReciprocal with the reciprocal of that modulus. Battery and targeted pass under a Salvador block override, and a timing probe could not detect the memo through publicnode. The released build remains to be tested after 8 December.
